simple.meaning: חֹמֶשׁ (chômesh) is a Hebrew word meaning “a fifth tax.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: This word has limited occurrence data, so BibleIQ begins with the Hebrew word, its basic meaning, and the verse where it appears.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to חֹמֶשׁ (H2569) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in חֹמֶשׁ (H2569) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: חֹמֶשׁ (chômesh) / H2569 is traced through Genesis 47:26 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.

firstOccurrence.englishText: Joseph made it a statute concerning the land of Egypt to this day, that Pharaoh should have the fifth. Only the land of the priests alone didn’t become Pharaoh’s.
